connector.name: Data Aggregator
connector.registryDescription: Find & fetch research datasets across 17 archives, omics registries, and literature sources.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package data-aggregator-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the musharna account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NCBI_API_KEY
env.description: Optional NCBI E-utilities API key; raises the rate limit 3->10 req/s for omics, literature, and taxonomy lookups.

env.name: LLM_API_BASE
env.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint; enables search(understand=true) and search(multi_query=true).

env.name: LLM_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer token for the LLM endpoint (LLM_API_BASE); omit for keyless local servers.

env.name: LLM_MODEL
env.description: Model name passed to the LLM endpoint (default: gpt-4o-mini); set to whatever your endpoint serves.

env.name: EMBEDDING_API_BASE
env.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint; enables search(rank=semantic) re-ranking.

env.name: EMBEDDING_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer token for the embeddings endpoint (EMBEDDING_API_BASE); omit for keyless local servers.

env.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
env.description: Model name passed to the embeddings endpoint (default: text-embedding-3-small).

env.name: DATA_GOV_API_KEY
env.description: Optional api.data.gov key for the data.gov source; without it requests fall back to the shared public DEMO_KEY, which is aggressively rate-limited.

env.name: UNPAYWALL_EMAIL
env.description: Email address sent to the Unpaywall API; required to enable the Unpaywall PDF fallback leg of literature full-text retrieval.

env.name: NCBI_EMAIL
env.description: Contact address sent to NCBI's ID converter; falls back to UNPAYWALL_EMAIL when unset.

env.name: DATAVERSE_BASE_URL
env.description: Resolve Dataverse DOIs against a different installation (default: https://dataverse.harvard.edu).

env.name: CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
env.description: Resolve-cache lifetime in seconds (default: 3600); an unparseable value falls back to the default.
